text:
sarah: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — summarizing action items for the streaming/chat reliability work. Want to make sure owners and timelines are clear. :spiral_calendar:

mike: Thanks. Can you paste the action list here? I'm happy to pick up the reconnect/backoff engineering tasks. @lee any objections?

sarah: Yep — copying what we agreed in the PM: 1) Harden reconnect/backoff logic on client + service, 2) Add server-side partial-response detection + explicit close codes, 3) Improve observability (prefix-level traces + sample payloads), 4) Run a week-long canary with aggressive synthetic load, 5) Post-deploy regression checks.

lee: I'll take (2) partial-response detection and the close codes. Plan is to add a validation step right before flush and emit a "partial_detected" metric + code 430 for protocol close. ETA end of next sprint (2 weeks).

mike: I'll own (1) reconnect/backoff implementation. Proposing exponential backoff with jitter and a max of 6 retries, but also add immediate fallback to a lighter model for long-running sessions. Working on a patch today; PR by end of week.

anita: I'll handle observability (3). Tasks: add prefix-level trace id propagation, a histogram for time-to-first-token, and a sampled payload store with redaction rules. ETA 10 business days. Need a quick decision on retention (30d vs 90d) from infra.

sarah: For (4) canary, ops-bot will schedule synthetic load. @ops-bot can you kick off the canary once the client and server changes land in staging?

ops-bot: scheduled: Canary job "chat-resilience-synth-1" created for staging on 2027-05-12 03:00 UTC. Will run 48 hours with ramp and spike phases. Reports will be posted in #eng-sre.

mike: Quick note on client behavior: some SDKs were aggressively reconnecting every 2s which amplified the outage. I added a client-side rate-limiter in the SDK to cap reopens to 1/min per session in the temporary patch. Need to make it configurable.

lee: For the close codes, let's document them in the protocol README. Suggested codes: 400 (bad request), 410 (session_expired), 430 (partial_response_detected), 449 (server_overload). Agree?

anita: Agree. Also adding a metric label 'reconnect_source' (client|server|network) to help root cause. Will post PR with the new metrics schema later today.

sarah: Ownership and dates: mike -> reconnect/backoff patch PR by 2027-05-07, lee -> partial detection PR by 2027-05-14, anita -> observability PR by 2027-05-11, ops -> canary runs 2027-05-12 to 2027-05-14. I'll own the rollout checklist and postmortem follow-up doc. Any blockers?

mike: One blocker: we need a gating test for regressions on latency (time-to-first-byte). Can we add an automated test in the CI that fails if median TTFB increases by >10% from baseline? @anita doable?

anita: Yes, I can add a monitoring CI job that runs the steady-state synthetic and compares percentiles. Will wire it to the PR pipeline.

lee: Regarding recurring patterns: I observed 3 incidents in last 6 weeks where partial responses coincided with kv-cache misses + model cold starts. We should consider a cache warm strategy during reconnects to reduce cold-start partials.

sarah: Good catch. Action: research warm-start/cache priming for reconnects — assign to platform-ideas backlog. ETA: spike next week. @mike can you attend the spike sync?

mike: Yep I'll join the spike sync. Also pruning ideas: graceful degrade to streaming-summary mode if response stalls after X tokens.

ops-bot: incident-note: link to original postmortem https://redwood.internal/postmortem/INC-2027-42

anita: Small implementation detail for sampled payloads: will redact keys matching /password|token|ssn/i and store only first 2k chars. Sound ok?

sarah: Yes — keep it conservative. Also we need privacy signoff from security for sampled payload retention. I'll loop in @security.

mike: I'll open the reconnect PR with this patch in the SDK: ```
reconnect:
  max_retries: 6
  base_delay_ms: 200
  max_delay_ms: 5000
  jitter: full
  backoff_strategy: exp
``` 
Expect initial review in 24h.

lee: After my PR, I will add e2e tests that inject truncated final frames to verify partial detection and code emission.

sarah: Ok team — I'll keep this thread as the canonical tracker. I'll update the follow-up doc with owners/dates and post links to each PR. Next sync Friday 10am PT. :thumbsup:

mike: LGTM. Thanks.

anita: +1

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync scheduled Fri 2027-05-07 17:00 UTC in #incidents."
